No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

In this workshop you practice oral-history interviewing with consent and source comparison.

All materials are provided. The session is adapted to your space, your timetable and the age of the participants.

What it covers

  • Prepare questions and consent protocol
  • Mock recorded interview
  • Compare testimony to documents
  • Create a respectful field note

How the time is spent

  1. Prepare questions and consent protocol 25 min

  2. Mock recorded interview 50 min

  3. Compare testimony to documents 65 min

  4. Create a respectful field note 40 min

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Prepare interview questions and a consent protocol for an oral-history interview.
  • Practise oral-history interviewing in a mock recorded interview.
  • Compare testimony with documents and write a respectful field note.

You take away

An interpretation sheet with questions to ask on site and suggested reading.
